James is from East Africa and currently a student pursing a Masters degree in Computer Science.

 He earned his Master of Public Administration from Pace University and Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Wilmington University.

 He currently serves as Deputy Director of Compliance for the City of New York, and previously enlisted in the United States Air Force where he managed a $570M fleet across five states, oversaw $11M in equipment and facilities, supervised 82 maintenance staff, and applied trend analysis to develop and administer a $45M annual budget, depot maintenance plans, and preventive maintenance schedules that extended fleet life.

 In his additional role as Unit Deployment and Security Manager, he overhauled the squadron recall process to ensure 100% accountability of over 420 members—cutting Major Accident Response Exercise (MARE) reporting time by 50%—while executing monthly anti-terrorism measures that were recognized as the #1 program in the Air Mobility Command in 2009.

My hobbies include:

 1. Reading tech blogs and articles to stay updated with the latest trends in technology.

 2. Coding and working on personal projects to enhance my programming skills.

 3. Playing football and basketball to stay active and enjoy team sports.

 4. Traveling and exploring new places to experience different cultures and cuisines.

 5. Listening to music and attending live concerts whenever possible.
